question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices $(2,1)$, $(5,1)$ and $(k,5)$. Comment on whether its area depends on $k$.
explanation:
Step 1: Apply the determinant formula
The area is $$\frac{1}{2}\left|\begin{vmatrix}2&1&1\\5&1&1\\k&5&1\end{vmatrix}\right|$$
Step 2: Expand the determinant
The determinant equals $$2(1-5)-1(5-k)+(25-k)$$
Step 3: Simplify
This gives $$-8-5+k+25-k=12$$ Notice that the terms containing $k$ cancel.
Step 4: Calculate and interpret the area
Therefore, the area is $$\frac{1}{2}|12|=6$$ square units. Hence, the area is independent of $k$.

options.A: $6$ square units; the area is independent of $k$.
options.B: $6k$ square units; the area depends on $k$.
options.C: $12$ square units; the area is independent of $k$.
options.D: $|k-6|$ square units; the area depends on $k$.
